geopolitics_summary: EU climate policy momentum threatened by populist surge in elections; Spain election risks climate rollback; Poland climate laws upheld by court.

themes.headline: EU backs COP31 electrification target; consensus reached on flagship pledge
themes.why_it_matters: Stronger EU electrification commitment increases long-term power demand signal and validates power infrastructure investment; supports higher structural power prices and renewable support mechanisms through 2030s.

themes.headline: Poland court rejects bid to overturn seven major climate laws
themes.why_it_matters: Upholds Poland's EU ETS compliance and decarbonisation obligations; removes risk of rollback on coal phase-out, supporting carbon price floor and reducing downside risk to EUA curve.

themes.headline: Spain election favours conservatives promising relaxed climate rules
themes.why_it_matters: Potential rollback of Spain's aggressive climate stance (currently EU's loudest champion) could weaken coal phase-out pressure and renewable auction pace; negative for EUA floor and power curve structuring.

themes.headline: EU capitals urge Brussels to swiftly sign UK electricity trading agreement
themes.why_it_matters: Electricity interconnector agreement with UK could increase cross-border arbitrage and flatten NW Europe power spreads; bearish for GB-EU DA spreads and Cal+1 differentials if delayed signature.

themes.headline: Global refinery inputs fell 4.8Mb/d in Q2 2026 after Middle East conflict
themes.why_it_matters: Crude supply disruption from Middle East conflict tightens global oil market; indirect bearish pressure on power via higher fuel-switch costs from gas to oil, but delayed recovery signal moderates near-term EU gas-via-LNG arb.

watchlist: Spain snap election late November—climate policy direction for EU coal phase-out and renewable support.
COP31 electrification commitments finalisation—watches long-term power demand and EUA cap trajectory.
EU-UK electricity interconnector signing—timing risk for DA spread arbitrage and TTF-GB coupling.
French election 2027—Mélenchon manifesto vs Brussels institutional framework may test nuclear/decarbonisation policy.
